meta.name: Masoom
meta.description: In the pursuit of justice for her deceased mother, a fierce Sana Kapoor fights her father and uncovers secrets that can impair her relationship with her family.

videos.title: Bhulekha
videos.overview: When Sana arrives for her mother's funeral, she senses that things are not as plain as they seem. Determined, she decides to find the truth even if it incurs her father's wrath.

videos.title: Muqaddar
videos.overview: After the funeral, Sana presses ahead to unravel the truth. She reconnects with an old friend and uncovers a repressed memory while her suspicion about her father solidifies.

videos.title: Rehnuma
videos.overview: Sana's quest for the truth brings her face to face with unsavory characters and uncomfortable revelations. The rest of the Kapoors have their own burdens to bear.

videos.title: Family Secrets
videos.overview: Confronted by danger, Sana takes a drastic step. The siblings trade their secrets. An old chapter in Sana's life finds answers, but it weighs heavily on her friend, Monty.

videos.title: Dheeth
videos.overview: The sudden turn of events takes a toll on the family, and Balraj's political aspirations take a hit. Sana struggles to navigate her relationship with her father.

videos.title: Majnu
videos.overview: All loose ends get tied as the family finally learns to open up and trust each other with their hidden secrets. Sana gets some much-needed closure, but a new chapter opens up.
